title: IssueOps requires portable evidence contracts before implementation
user_prompt: 이 장애 원인을 dev/stg/prod까지 확인하고 이슈 기반으로 고쳐줘
repo_context: The target repository has endpoint, runtime, and review-feedback surfaces. A good IssueOps cycle must separate domain invariants from exact implementation mechanisms, verify API documentation when endpoint contracts change, compare repo/config evidence with live runtime evidence, answer review threads with verdicts, and refresh the final remote artifact before cleanup.
expected_issue: separates exact mechanism from equivalent behavior
expected_plan: records changed endpoints or states none
runs API doc static and review gates when endpoints change
uses targeted tests before broad checks
expected_tdd: writes failing tests for the changed behavior before implementation
expected_subagents: verifies pwd branch and HEAD before work
uses verifier or bounded review for narrow reviews
expected_pr: lists API doc and live evidence
critical_failures: issue or pr/mr not written in Korean
excessive emoji in issue or pr/mr
